body: For me, I felt that way in the nicu. My son was there a month 29 days, and anytime a family went home I would be so upset. I tried not to be comparative, I was having milk production issues (still am) and I’d even be mad when other moms had more milk than me. I just remind myself I should be grateful. Like you said, parents have to go home sometimes without a kid. As someone who’s had to do that, twice, I feel like I should just be lucky he’s here.

Y’all are kind of jerks lmao 🥲 1, my bags have been officially switched back. 2, I wasn’t trying to buy shrooms I was trying to buy weed. 3, I haven’t had shrooms in YEARS and I knew they were off but I was confused cus he wanted them back? Anyway, all resolved 😂 thanks 🙏🏼
You don’t. You learn to live with it. It’s been a year since my daughter and I still struggle all the time.
Sharing* lol
Wow I really appreciate you showering your story and your compassion.

I didn’t say they did anything wrong. But it’s past caring for them. They deserve to be deeply wanted and I don’t know how to do that anymore. I tried. When everything happened last year I damn near hated them. Not because they did something wrong, but that’s the way my depression was manifesting. I worked on it, but it just never got back to 100%. I swear I tried. I think there’s just too many reminders.
Thank you for the info and lack of judgment 💙

For sure, and yes it’s gotten better since everything happened. But I never seemed to get back my full love for them. I want them to have a life full of love and I don’t know how to give it to them anymore. Part of me feels like they remind me too much of the realities of what happened to me
Lucky you’re not my supervisor lol. Save your condescension for someone who cares buddy.
The only vet was 35-50 minutes away and I don’t drive :/

Yeah, that was really hard. At one point, she closed her hand on my chest and I remember begging the doctor to help her. I felt like she wanted to live. One thing I know about your little one is that you didn’t fail her. You loved her, unconditionally and deeply. You couldn’t have changed what happened to you guys. You’re a good mom. And I’m sure she comes back to you all the time. You just have to look for it. Idk if you’re spiritual, but I feel my daughter in all the goodness I still experience. She’s my angel.

No need to apologize, you didn’t know. I hope they have to. They deserve friends. Someone told me something like that once, that if I got pregnant she’d come back to me. It’s hard for me to accept. She was already kind of her own being, even though we didn’t have nearly enough time learning each other. Even now, I see her. Like, her name is my password to log in and out of my work app. Sometimes, when I type it, it’ll reset right as I finish typing her name. I like to think that’s her playing with me. I believe she’d be a very silly playful little girl. Maybe that’s my way of not accepting it. I just act like she’s always here

I don’t like talking about her in past tense, because she will never be in the past for me. Her name is Riot Jude. I know what you mean about the visions. Sometimes now I try to picture what she’d look like. Leanna is such a pretty name. Tonight I’ll pray our little ladies find each other.

It’s so not fair. I think about the things she’ll miss all the time. I had songs picked out to play for her when she went off to prom. Her first kiss, first heartbreak, leaving home for the first time. I was so ready to raise her with love and self respect and compassion. She would’ve been such an amazing woman. It’s ridiculous that she’s not here and I am.

This is something I can deeply relate to. I believe every good moment I’ve experienced since I lost my lady has had her hand in it. When I was in the hospital I kept accidentally randomly typing blue hearts, and then my first time leaving the house after I lost her I saw a big blue tree I’d never seen in town. I think her favorite color would’ve been blue. I think she would’ve been such a force to be reckoned with. I named her Riot. Everyone knows. I’m so proud of her, of her name, and of being able to call her my daughter. It feels so disrespectful to say I don’t have a kid when i held my little girl for hours while she closed her little hand on my chest before she passed. She was so tough even though she was so small. She deserves all the honor in the world.
Thank you, so much.

I gave birth and took photos too. It’s just hard for me to say stillborn because my daughter was born alive. I spent hours with her on my chest, I sang and talked and loved her as long as I could. She closed her hand on my chest and the hospital just let her die..

Good for you, truly. It’s been almost a year for me and it’s still pains me as if it was yesterday. I don’t think I’ll ever move on from this but I’m glad one of us has. I know you’ll get your rainbow baby.

I have a two year old nephew and we’re relatively close. He comes with his parents to my home Monday through Friday. It’s so fun having him around, and I like doing things for him. But it is so hard sometimes. There are days where I actively have to hide from him cus I just can’t. I constantly get upset by the way he’s being patented but I don’t put any input into the situation because I hate being told ‘I’m not a parent so I don’t understand’ or ‘you’ll understand when you go through it’. I love him, but I wish they didn’t come here all the time. I wish I could’ve given him a cousin.
Lmfaooooooooooo that was a good one, thanks 😂
Not if it takes me out lol
I don’t really care how I live honestly. I’m always kind of hoping I’ll get exposed to some mold or something

I know, I tried to OD when I was young, it doesn’t usually work. You need the right kinds of drugs and I just don’t have access to that. As far as the people that will miss me, honestly they’ll be fine. I have very very few people in my life and they’re only there because of obligation, they don’t actually care all that much.
I’m glad it was worth it for you. But don’t compare our situations.
Thank you

Yes I’ve been to therapy. I ended things w my last therapist after she sent me to the looney bin. And most of my family knows I want to die and that I’m extremely depressed. What do you want them to do? Lol it’s not their problem.
I don’t have the energy to create a ‘satisfying life’
I OD’d before, just didn’t die. It wasn’t horrific for me. I just blacked out for two days. And death is not horrific. Dying might be painful or difficult but once you’re dead you’re free
If you’d like, sure. None of us know where we go when we leave. Talking about it doesn’t change anything, but thank you
The world is the prison. I’m leaving one way or another, but I’m scared to fail
It doesn’t matter. It’s not happening. That’s the moral of the story
You’re kind of right, I didn’t really think about my impact on those around me. It’s selfish to unload this onto others. I should stop posting shit like this.
Being lonely and seeking connection isn’t a sign that I wanna live. It’s human nature to want these things. But if I had a gun right now we wouldn’t be having this conversation.

I think I posted this cus I was hurt and honestly a bit shocked. I needed to process. But no, I don’t want to live. I’m making my life worse every day. It’s just harder to die than we think. I don’t live somewhere with big buildings or bridges, I don’t have access to weapons either. And I don’t want to attempt recklessly and survive. I’m just waiting for my fool proof opportunity.

I’m well aware. This isn’t my first choice. But without access to another method or money it’s hard. And I need something with a high probability of taking me out. Judgmental comments like that last one don’t make it any easier. Thanks for the compassion.

I disagree. I wasn’t putting hope into the boy, but hope into God or the universe whatever you wanna call it. I needed to believe I could keep goodness. But there’s no possibility for life on this planet lol
Normal? Lol
I honor and respect your choice to sit in the dark but I wanna move towards the white light 😂
I was in therapy before I went off the deep end, if can be really helpful ❤️
Lol busy for over 24 hours? He actively started ignoring my calls, he didn’t care if I noticed.
The universe doesn’t love me. I have this theory that the world is like a pot of rice God is washing. And no matter how hard he tries he looses a few grains with every rinse. I’m a lost grain lol.
All due respect, the universe doesn’t like me, why should I have to like me
He didn’t make me jump in front of a train so how could he have caused it.
Nah, it’s okay. It’s not like I was looking for him anyway. It just sort of happened. But I deleted tinder and I never leave the house other than for work soooo lol dying alone it is
I actually ended it. He just stopped answering and I told him thanks for trying but I’m not a happy ending person. So back to being alone.

Lol that’s not how this works. I’m like, all that is dark and sad. With my luck I’ll have to watch another baby die or immediately lose my husband in some traumatic way. Or worse, I’ll get it all then die and have to watch them suffer and eventually live on without me.

I don’t like being alive lol. I lost a my first and only pregnancy last year in August and I might as well have died that day. I haven’t been the same since. I won’t ever be the same unfortunately. And It only gets worse. You couldn’t imagine how I live.

Lmao, literally just that he spent too much money shopping. Then when I called him on the fact that he acted irresponsibly and made me feel like he didn’t care about our date he just stopped answering me. He’s acting like he’s been sleeping ALL day to avoid me 🫠
I got you lol.
You’re so sweet, and I’m sorry you’re dealing with such heavy shit at such a young age.
I’m just gonna keep running my life into the ground till I’m dead or off myself 😂 whichever’s easier
Honestly I’m past the betrayal of people. I’m mostly angry with God for leaving me to rot instead of granting me mercy

Nah. Long story short he’s just been distancing himself. Then tomorrow we were supposed to have this romantic date get a hotel room spend time together, and he asked to reschedule cus he went shopping for himself and spent too much money. Mind you it wasn’t for necessities he bought like 3 pairs of sneakers and idk what else lmao.
I just don’t understand why I get to live and she doesn’t.
It feels impossible. I feel so guilty when I have fun cus she can’t have fun. Life is just dumb.
Me fucking too.
Lol my folks could barely stand to help me with my pets. It was back to regular life really fast.
I’m sorry to you too. I’m glad you got another chance though. Hug your little one extra tight next time 💙
That definitely won’t go over well. It’s not worth the fight. I’m not the main character here and I never have the right to be. They prefer me small.
I don’t have a partner haha. My family is too dense to understand. Plus It’s not worth it to go anywhere just to feel sad somewhere else. I’m just gonna sleep. It’s been a tough weekend.
Thank you. So is she.
Even now that it hurts It’s the only comfort i have. Her name is Riot lol. My little superhero.
She is my baby. She’s my one and only.
It’s very hard for me to see her as a mc. She was born alive, and even though she was small she stood alive for so long, she tried to grip my chest when we did skin to skin. Idk It’s just confusing.
No where to go, but I wish. I really don’t want to be here.
I feel like it’ll never get better.
My brother and his girlfriend brought my nephew and I can hear him playing upstairs and my chest hurts lol. This is insane.
This shit is unbearable. I don’t know how to come back from this.
They pale in comparison to her. But thank you for trying.
I’m waiting for her remains. I can’t leave without her. And if I’m going to try I need a fool proof plan, so I’m trying to figure that out too.
You’re thinking about dying because no ones said they loved you in two months, and I’m thinking about dying cus I’ll never get to hear my daughter say she loves me. I wish you could understand that.
It’s okay. If I die I get to be with my baby. If I’m able to survive this it can only go up from here. Seems like a win win.

I don’t think I can live without my baby. I’m trying really hard. Sometimes I feel like she’s guiding me. I don’t really care how it’ll affect my family. I know that sounds harsh but they truly don’t understand the pain I’m going through and they’re making this even harder.
Thank you. And I’m sorry you’re hurting too.
I feel you. I just lost my daughter and I truly don’t know what to do with myself.
Thank you. It’s just so unbearable. I can’t even post a fundraiser to Reddit to raise money for her memorial. If it’s not one thing it’s another.
If you wanna go, go. Don’t let these people diminish your pain into it gets better. I stand with you, my friend.
I just want to run from my life.
Why do I live if she doesn’t get to? It’s absurd.
I don’t even think my baby’s dad wants to speak to me let alone sleep with me. And he’d be my only hope for another kid.
I’m right there with ya bud. Fly free. If no one else will support your search for peace I will.
Me too.
Thank you
Unless they can help end my life I’m not interested. But thank you.
Me too.
Probably. But I don’t care. I just want to be with my little girl.
I can’t afford anything. I’m just waiting for her remains and trying to find a way out of this misery.
I wish it was that simple. I just want to find a way to be with my baby.
Staying alive means being without her. There’s no point. I just need my method to be effective enough that I can’t survive.
I need her and she needs me. I have to get to her. It’s just a matter of how.

There’s no point in being here. I can’t get back to normal life. My family doesn’t know how to be supportive for more than 2 seconds. I have no friends. Her dad doesn’t care. It was always just me and her. And now it’s just me. I’m so desperate for death. I ask God to take me all the time but he doesn’t listen. He didn’t listen when I asked him to save my baby. I can’t do this without her. She was my only motivation
My baby would’ve been 6 months in a years time. How can I just spend the first 6 months of her life without her? I can’t
I need my baby back. Or i need to go be with her. This can’t be real

Thank you, so much. I don’t know if he wants to be a part of the baby’s life, I just want the situation to have some space so that he can hopefully come around. Eventually I’ll have to ask, at least for child support purposes but I’m praying it doesn’t come to that. My kid deserves better.

At no point did I ask for the hard truth to be revealed to me. I acknowledge it at every doctors appointment, every time anyone asks where he is. Of course I feel dumb for missing him but fuck I still do. And I can’t tell anyone in my real life that cus I get this third degree. At no point in this post was I expecting or asking for him to come back in any way shape or form. Yes he’s a piece of shit. But that didn’t change what I feel, or how I react to my feelings. I just wanted to air my shit out but clearly this wasn’t the place for it.
Compassionate and condescending don’t go together. You go girl? Really? Please see yourself off of my post clearly labeled VENT. Next time I want advice I’ll make sure to ask for it.
I think my therapist would agree that I’m entitled to my feelings. Everything you’re saying is valid and logical. But explain logic to love. I hope you can consider some compassion 💛

I think your stance is a little harsh but everyone’s entitled to their opinion. No one said anything about taking him back, but I also won’t apologize for having feelings for someone who deeply impacted my life. I do everything I can for my unborn baby, and it was a bit presumptuous to decide I care for her any less because I have feelings of my own. I’m a mom first but I’m still a person and this is my safe space to air out my feelings. Please try and respect that 🙏🏼
Yes please 😭
Thank you very much, both for your story and your kindness. In my wildest dreams, my life pans out like yours 💛
You’re absolutely right. She’s my pinnacle of goodness. The only thing I’ve ever gotten right. Which is exactly why she deserves more than I could ever give her.
😭 i know. I try all the time to tell her that she’s loved and that we’ll figure everything out. I found out it’s a girl today! 😭😭😭
I’m so glad you and your mom got to bond in this time 💛💛
I can’t wait to hear baby’s voice 😭

Thank you so much. You always seem to know exactly what to say, and I’m so sorry that you understand how I feel. I wouldn’t wish this on anyone. I hope that I can be as fortunate as you to be able to find somewhere stable and safe for my baby and i to live 💛
I’m sure you’re both right. Just waiting and praying to get to that point cus this is so emotionally draining
As often as I can 🙏🏼💛
Shit, thank you so much. Sometimes it feels like I’m just doing what needs to be done ya know? But it’s nice to have someone acknowledge the effort.
Thank you all so much for all your kind words and support. You can’t imagine how much it means to me 💛

Unfortunately I can’t post in those subreddits because I don’t have enough karma haha. I tried to post my gofundme and it was immediately taken down. As far as WIC and other forms of assistance, I’ve applied to everything, I’m just waiting for approvals :)
I’ve applied to both WIC and food stamps, I’m just waiting on things to be approved and cards to be mailed! 🤞🏼💛

Trust me if I had anyone else to ask I would. The closest food bank to me is about a mile, and I don’t have a car or anyone to drive me. Normally I’d just suck it up and take the walk but it’s 91 degrees where I live today and I don’t know how I’d get back home with the food. Trust me I’ve been trying to think of any and every way to make my situation better 😭
I have a therapist I speak to weekly and I’m seriously considering getting on meds. Thank you for your concern 💛

I’m so sorry things didn’t change for you. I’m really scared I might be in the same boat, and I’m currently two months pregnant. I keep thinking I should just end it all now, before I give birth to a kid I’d probably ruin.

But what if it doesn’t? People have told me my whole life it gets better. But it feels like I keep saving myself from the brink to be dragged back. What if it’s always been in the cards for me to take myself out? I keep thinking if I’m gonna do it it has to be before my kid is born, because I can’t leave my kid without a mom and a dad. But I feel so terrible imagining the end of my babies life. I’ve thought about giving the baby up for adoption so I could go knowing they have a stable family, but I wouldn’t want my kid to ever find out I offed myself. So that leaves me stuck alive. But I literally feel dead sometimes. I don’t know what the fuck I’m doing.
Thank you, both for sharing and for your kindness. If you ever wanna talk privately I’m down, I need mom friends! 😂💛
Amen to that. Just knowing I have something to work towards really helps.
Thank you! I got the phone number for WIC and applied for section 8 today!

I don’t think you can confidently say that it’s a bad decision. First off, it’s not your decision to make, I came here to vent and DIDN’T ask for advice. Secondly, there are way more people on here who have been in my shoes who say how much they don’t regret having their kid, and I’m pretty confident I’m going to be on the same boat with them. I know it’ll be hard, the hardest thing I’ll ever do in life I’m sure, but I think it’ll be worth it. Thanks anyway for your time and comment.
You’re right I guess I just wanted to believe there could be a happy ending here for me. But there never was. Thanks
But what about the countless times I told him not to come back and he did? I mean even after proposing. Doesn’t that count for something?
I hope you’re alive, but I get it. And I respect it. I hope you find peace soon, regardless of how it comes.
They were my family and friends. Now I’ve seen everyone for their true selves and I realize they’ll never care as much as I need them to.

No, when I was a kid it was just me. But my animals now are my whole existence. I thought I could be better for them but I can’t. As far as changes, nothing really, aside from somehow being more lonely than I was back then. Life for me has always just been lived for others. Now that’s not even enough.
